chapter: The Washingtonians, Bechet and drum style
title: Singing risque songs for tips with Fats
summary: Greer recalls singing 'My Buddy' and risque numbers around the floor and the tips coming in.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: But that's just you know, you're thinking fast. Think fast. I know when me and Fats was singing, come around on the floor, I used to sing "My Buddy" and all them popular songs. One night feeling good, I sang a couple of risqué songs. Oh, so man I come out and the hostess is sitting there and them drunks, they loved it. Man, money just flying and the cat -- one cat wanted to give me a couple dollars.. The hostess say, "What's Sonny going to do with - two dollars don't give him two dollars. he's going to make it anyhow. Give him five or ten. What's the matter with you."
He didn't want to be showed up. He come over to me. (Unintelligible) they looking out for me. Looking out for little brothers. Looking out for the bruz....(Laughter)
